name: nc/section
title: Section
description: Full-width band with an inner container.
aiHints: Each horizontal band of the page is a section. Choose the tag by role: main, header, footer, nav, aside or section. Use anchor (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens) for links inside the page, for example #subscribe. A section with a child section is a transparent wrapper: its inner box loses width and padding and all its direct children go full width, so keep only sections inside it.
